name: Warmage
body:
There are many arcane academies that teach spellcasters their art. They learn esoteric lore and research new applications for their craft. Magic can be creative, but it can also be horribly destructive. However, in some cultures, or in times of great war, academies are formed to teach the spellcasting art of war.

Role: The role of the warmage is an offensive wizard. They learn and practice offensive spells, with a smattering of defense. The exact nature of this defense depends upon the arcane strategies learned by the warmage.

Alignment: Any. Most warmages tend toward lawful given their typical employment in militaries, but that is not always the case.

Hit Die: d8

Starting Wealth: 4d6 × 10 gp (average 140 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The warmage’s class skills are: Craft (Int), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Knowledge (geography) (Int), Knowledge (history) (Int), Profession (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks per Level: 2 + Int modifier

Class Features

The following are the class features of the warmage.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A warmage is proficient with all simple weapons. A warmage is also proficient with light armor and light shields. They can cast warmage spells while wearing light armor or wielding a light shield without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. Like any other arcane spellcaster, a warmage wearing medium armor, heavy armor, or a heavy or tower shield incurs a chance of arcane spell failure if the spell in question has a somatic component. A multiclass warmage still incurs the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes.

Arcane Strategy

At 1st level, a warmage gains a talent that exemplifies their tactical magic training. See the arcane strategies section on page 3 for the choices available. The warmage gains another arcane strategy at 3rd level and every odd level thereafter. An arcane strategy may not be taken multiple times unless otherwise noted.

Combat Casting

At 1st level, a warmage gains Combat Casting as a bonus feat.

Spellcasting

A warmage casts arcane spells drawn from the wizard spell list; however, they are limited to spells from the evocation and abjuration schools. There are certain arcane strategies that allow them to add spells from other spell schools to their spell list. A warmage must choose and prepare their spells ahead of time.

To learn, prepare, or cast a spell, the warmage must have an Intelligence score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a warmage’s spell is 10 + the spell level + their Intelligence modifier.

A warmage can cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. Their base daily spell allotment is given on the table below. Additionally, they receive bonus spells per day if they have a high Intelligence score.

A warmage may know any number of spells. They must choose and prepare their spells ahead of time by getting 8 hours of sleep and spending 1 hour studying their spellbook. While studying, the warmage decides which spells to prepare.

Cantrips: A warmage can prepare a number of cantrips, or 0-level spells, each day, as noted on the table below. These spells are cast like any other spell, but they are not expended when cast and may be used again.

Spellbooks: A warmage must study their spellbook each day to prepare their spells. They cannot prepare any spell not recorded in their spellbook. A warmage begins play with a spellbook containing all 0-level warmage spells plus three 1st-level warmage spells of their choice. The warmage also selects a number of additional 1st-level warmage spells equal to their Intelligence modifier to add to their spellbook. At each new warmage level, they gain two new warmage spells of any spell level or levels that they can cast (based on their new warmage level) for their spellbook. At any time, a warmage can also add spells found in other spellbooks to their own.

A warmage can learn spells from a wizard’s spellbook, just as a wizard can from a warmage’s spellbook. The spells learned must be on the warmage spell list, as normal. An alchemist can learn formulae from a warmage’s spellbook, if the spells are also on the alchemist spell list. A warmage cannot learn spells from an alchemist.

Focused Mind (Ex)

At 2nd level, a warmage gains a +2 bonus to their concentration checks. This stacks with the benefit from Combat Casting. This bonus increases by +2 at 9th and 16th levels.

Bonus Feat

At 4th, 12th, and 20th levels, a warmage gains a bonus feat for which they meet the prerequisites. The bonus feat must be a metamagic feat, a feat that bypasses spell resistance, or a feat that increases the saving throws or attack rolls of their spells.

Sudden Empower

At 6th level, a warmage gains Sudden Metamagic for Empower Spell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

Armored Mage (Ex)

At 8th level, a warmage gains proficiency with medium armor and heavy shields. A warmage can cast warmage spells while wearing/using medium armor and heavy shields without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. Like any other arcane spellcaster, a warmage wearing heavy armor or using a tower shield incurs a chance of arcane spell failure if the spell in question has a somatic component.

Sudden Enlarge: At 10th level, a warmage gains Sudden Metamagic for Enlarge Spell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.
Sudden Widen: At 14th level, a warmage gains Sudden Metamagic for Widen Spell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.
Sudden Maximize: At 18th level, a warmage gains Sudden Metamagic for Maximize Spell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.
War Incarnate (Ex)

At 20th level, a warmage has reached the pinnacle of war magic. A warmage gains one additional cantrip and one additional slot of each other spell level, all of which must be used to prepare evocation spells. Additionally, their base attack bonus increases by 5 for spell attack rolls.

Battle Focus (Su)

You can focus your mind on a target, using your arcane power to make the target seem to be moving in slow motion to your senses. As a swift action, you can designate a target to gain this benefit against for 1 round/level. For the duration, you gain a +2 insight bonus to AC, Reflex saves, CMD, attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, Sense Motive, and Perception checks against the target. You can select another simultaneous target at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter. You must be able to sense the target to gain these benefits. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier.

Bonded Spell (Su)

You select any one spell that you know as a bonded spell. As a full-round action, you may replace a spell of the same or higher level as your bonded spell with your bonded spell. For example, if you select magic missile as your bonded spell, you could spend a full-round action to exchange any 1st-level or higher spell that you have prepared with magic missile.

At 3rd level, and every two levels thereafter, you may select another spell you know and add it to your list of bonded spells, to a maximum of nine bonded spells at 17th level.

Upon reaching 4th level, and every two levels thereafter, you can choose to select a new spell as a bonded spell in place of one with which you are already bonded. In effect, you lose the bond with the old spell, though it is still one of your spells known, in exchange for forging a bond with a new spell. The new spell’s level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged. You may swap only one bonded spell at any given level, and must choose whether or not to swap the bonded spell at the same time that you gain two new spells known for the level.

Dimensional Tactics (Ex)

You gain Dimensional Agility as a bonus feat; alternatively, you may choose any 1 feat that lists Dimensional Agility as a prerequisite as a bonus feat instead. You must meet the prerequisites of the feat chosen. This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting a new bonus feat each time.

Arcane Strategies
Elemental Bolt (Sp)

As a standard action, you can unleash an elemental bolt targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The elemental bolt deals 1d6 damage + 1 per warmage level you possess. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. The damage type dealt by this bolt is chosen when this ability is gained from among the following: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. This arcane strategy maybe selected multiple times, granting an additional element you can choose from when using this ability and 2 additional uses per day. Only one damage type can be employed in a use of this ability. Once you have all the damage types, you gain 3 uses per acquisition of this ability thereafter.

Empowering Tactics (Ex)

You add a transmutation spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level.

Familiar (Su)

You gain a familiar as per the wizard arcane bond. You use your warmage class levels as effective wizard levels to determine the progression of your familiar.

Force Missile (Sp)

As a standard action, you can unleash a force missile that automatically strikes a foe, as per the spell magic missile. The force missile deals 1d4 points of damage plus your warmage level. This is a force effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting 3 additional uses of the ability. Additionally, for each selection after the first, you can expend an additional use as part of the same standard action to fire an additional force bolt at another target in range, or the same target. After the 3rd selection of this ability, you only gain 3 uses per day per selection thereafter.

Intense Spells (Su)

Whenever you cast an evocation spell that deals hit point damage, add 1/2 your warmage level to the damage (minimum +1). This bonus only applies once to a spell, not once per missile or ray, and cannot be split between multiple missiles or rays. This bonus damage is not increased by Empower Spell or similar effects.

Lingering Evocations (Su)

Any evocation spell you cast with a duration greater than instantaneous lasts an additional number of rounds equal to 1/2 your warmage level (minimum +1).

Predictive Spells (Ex)

You add a divination spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level.

Reserve Tactics (Ex)

Select any 1 reserve feat whose prerequisites you meet – you gain that reserve feat as a bonus feat. This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting a different reserve feat each time. Reserve feat info can be found on page 25.

Resistance (Ex)

You gain resistance 5 to an energy type of your choice, chosen when you prepare spells.

This resistance can be changed each day. When you select this arcane strategy a second time at 9th level or later, this resistance increases to 10. If you select this arcane strategy a third time at 17th level or later, this resistance becomes immunity to the chosen energy type.

Shift (Su)

You can teleport to a nearby space as a swift action as if using dimension door. This movement does not provoke an attack of opportunity. You must be able to see the space that you are moving into. You cannot take other creatures with you when you use this arcane strategy (except for familiars, if applicable). You can move 5 feet for every two warmage levels you possess (minimum 5 feet). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier.

This arcane strategy may be selected multiple times, granting 3 additional uses per day.

Specialized Weaponry (Su)

You gain a bonded object as the wizard arcane bond except that the object must be a weapon. You use your warmage class levels as effective wizard levels to determine any level based effects of this feature.

Additionally, you gain proficiency in the chosen weapon and whenever you cast an evocation spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage your weapon becomes empowered with that energy. Until the end of your next turn, any attacks made with the weapon deals additional damage of that energy type equal to the level of the spell cast.

Spell Precision (Ex)

You gain the benefits of the Precise Shot feat but only for your spells. This counts as the feat for prerequisite purposes. If you select this tactic a second time, you also ignore any soft cover provided to your target caused by one of your allies.

You can only select this arcane strategy twice.

Summoner’s Tricks (Ex)

You add a conjuration spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The 5 spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level.

Trickery (Ex)

You add an illusion spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, gaining new spells for each level.

Versatile Evocations (Su)

When you cast an evocation spell that does acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, you may change the damage dealt to one of the other four energy types. This changes the descriptor of the spell to match the new energy type. Any nondamaging effects remain unchanged unless the new energy type invalidates them (an ice storm that deals fire damage might still provide a penalty on Perception checks due to smoke, but it would not create difficult terrain). Such effects are subject to GM discretion. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting 3 additional uses per day.
